class.name: JRPGTroopData
class.brief_description: A troop: the enemies fought together.
class.description: Database entry for a group of up to [constant MAX_MEMBERS] enemies and its battle events. Encounters and battle commands always name a troop, even for a single enemy.

method.name: make_member
method.description: Returns a member dictionary for [member members]: enemy [param enemy_id] at [param position], hidden until a battle event makes it appear when [param hidden] is [code]true[/code].

members.member: The troop's enemies, as dictionaries with [code]enemy_id[/code], [code]x[/code], [code]y[/code] and [code]hidden[/code]. Their order is the order of targets in battle.

constants.constant: Largest number of enemies in a troop.
